reportingFramework.description: The framework this entry is booked under. Absent means Dutch GAAP (reporting-ifrs-calculations REQ-DGAAP-011).
reportingFramework.title: Reporting framework

divergenceReasonCode.description: Marks the entry as measured differently under the other framework. With an adjustment calculation, posting derives the other framework's entry and the reconciling difference (REQ-DGAAP-011).
divergenceReasonCode.title: Divergence reason

adjustmentCalculationId.description: The StandardSpecificCalculation whose outputs carry the amount under the other framework: `ifrsAmount` for an entry booked under Dutch GAAP, `rjAmount` for one booked under IFRS.
adjustmentCalculationId.title: Adjustment calculation
